72989-jinrikisha-days-in-japan.title: Jinrikisha Days In Japan
72989-jinrikisha-days-in-japan.creator: Eliza Ruhamah Scidmore
72989-jinrikisha-days-in-japan.description: A book by Eliza Ruhamah Scidmore. All the Orient is a surprise to the Occidental. Everything is strange, with a certain unreality that makes one doubt half his sensations. To appreciate Japan one should come to it from the mainland of Asia. From Suez to Nagasaki the Asiatic sits dumb and contented in his dirt, rags, ignorance, and wretchedness.

Speagle (沈佳士), Vedant Chandra, Benjamin D. Johnson, Turner Woody, Jiwon Jesse Han. The Milky Way’s satellite galaxies (“surviving dwarfs”) have been studied for decades as unique probes of chemical evolution in the low-mass regime. Here we extend such studies to the “disrupted dwarfs”, whose debris constitutes the stellar halo.

arxiv-2309-02782.creator: Matthew Bisatt and Ross Paterson
arxiv-2309-02782.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Matthew Bisatt and Ross Paterson. We study the behaviour of conductors of L L -functions associated to certain Weil–Deligne representations under twisting. For each global field K K we prove a sharp upper bound for the conductor of the Rankin–Selberg L L -function L ⁡ ( A ⊠ B , s ) L(A\boxtimes B,s) where A , B / K A,B/K are abelian varieties. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 11S40 (11G40 11G10 14G10) 1.

arxiv-2309-16291.title: Efficiency Separation between RL Methods: Model-Free, Model-Based and Goal-Conditioned
arxiv-2309-16291.creator: Brieuc Pinon, Raphaël Jungers, Jean-Charles Delvenne
arxiv-2309-16291.description: Abstract We prove a fundamental limitation on the efficiency of a wide class of Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms. This limitation applies to model-free RL methods as well as a broad range of model-based methods, such as planning with tree search.

arxiv-2407-00121.title: Granite-Function Calling Model: Introducing Function Calling Abilities via Multi-task Learning of Granular Tasks
arxiv-2407-00121.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown tremendous promise in serving as the backbone to agentic systems, as demonstrated by their performance in multi-faceted, challenging benchmarks like SWE-Bench and Agent-Bench. However, to realize the true potential of LLMs as autonomous agents, they must learn to identify, call, and interact with external tools and application program interfaces (APIs) to complete complex tasks. These tasks together are termed function calling .

arxiv-2409-08893.title: The M ∙ M_{\bullet} – σ e \sigma_{e} relation for local type 1 AGNs and quasars
arxiv-2409-08893.creator: J. Molina, L. C. Ho, K. K. Knudsen
arxiv-2409-08893.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by J. Molina, L. C. Ho, K. K. Knudsen. We analyzed Multi Unit Spectroscopic Explorer observations of 42 local z ≲ 0.1 z\lesssim 0.1 type 1 active galactic nucleus (AGN) host galaxies taken from the Palomar-Green quasar sample and the close AGN reference survey. Our goal was to study the relation between the black hole mass ( M ∙ M_{\bullet} ) and bulge stellar velocity dispersion ( σ e \sigma_{e} ) for type 1 active galaxies.

arxiv-2503-08102.title: AI-native Memory 2.0: Second Me
arxiv-2503-08102.creator: Jiale Wei Xiang Ying Tao Gao Fangyi Bao Felix Tao Jingbo Shang
arxiv-2503-08102.description: Abstract Human interaction with the external world fundamentally involves the exchange of personal memory, whether with other individuals, websites, applications, or, in the future, AI agents. A significant portion of this interaction is redundant, requiring users to repeatedly provide the same information across different contexts.

arxiv-2510-03349.title: AgentCaster: Reasoning-Guided Tornado Forecasting
arxiv-2510-03349.creator: Michael Chen
arxiv-2510-03349.description: Abstract There is a growing need to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) on complex, high-impact, real-world tasks to assess their true readiness as reasoning agents. To address this gap, we introduce AgentCaster, a contamination-free framework employing multimodal LLMs end-to-end for the challenging, long-horizon task of tornado forecasting. Within AgentCaster, models interpret heterogeneous spatiotemporal data from a high-resolution convection-allowing forecast archive.

arxiv-2511-07689.title: Stress Testing Factual Consistency Metrics for Long-Document Summarization
arxiv-2511-07689.creator: Zain Muhammad Mujahid, Dustin Wright, Isabelle Augenstein
arxiv-2511-07689.description: Abstract Evaluating the factual consistency of abstractive text summarization remains a significant challenge, particularly for long documents, where conventional metrics struggle with input length limitations and long-range dependencies. In this work, we systematically evaluate the reliability of six widely used reference-free factuality metrics, originally proposed for short-form summarization, in the long-document setting.

pmc-11335409.creator: Amrita Ladwa, Omar Elghawy, Varinder Kaur
pmc-11335409.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objectives This study aimed to report clinical outcomes of patients with vaginal melanoma (VaM) or vulvar melanoma (VuM) who were treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) and discuss the development of immune-related adverse events (irAE). Materials and Methods This is a retrospective case series of patients diagnosed with VaM or VuM between July 2011 and September 2022 at the University of Virginia, Emily Couric Clinical Cancer Center. Patient demographics, disease characteristics, treatment outcomes, and adverse events were abstracted.
